spells/aligned-aura-581.name: Aligned Aura
spells/aligned-aura-581.effectSummary: Choose chaos, evil, good, or law, normally from the caster's own non-neutral alignment component. A 20-foot aura grants the spell's listed bonuses to creatures sharing that component, while creatures of the opposed alignment must make a Fortitude save or take the listed penalties; these modifiers end when a creature leaves the aura. Before the duration expires, the caster can discharge the aura in a 60-foot burst: opposed-alignment creatures take 1d4 damage per remaining round (maximum 15d4), Fortitude half, while same-alignment creatures heal 1 hit point per remaining round (maximum 15). Discharging ends the spell.

spells/alter-self-2774.name: Alter Self
spells/alter-self-2774.effectSummary: Assumes the form of a creature of the caster's own type, within one size category and with Hit Dice no greater than caster level (maximum 5 HD). The caster keeps ability scores, class/level, hit points, alignment, base attack and save bonuses, creature type/subtype, spellcasting, supernatural and spell-like abilities that the new body can physically use, and class-derived extraordinary abilities. The new form supplies physical qualities such as size, mundane movement modes (capped at 120 feet flying or 60 feet otherwise), natural armor and weapons, racial skill bonuses, racial bonus feats, and body shape, but not its extraordinary, supernatural, or spell-like abilities. Templates are prohibited. Equipment remains worn or held if the new form can use it; otherwise it melds and becomes nonfunctional until reversion. Using the form as a disguise grants +10 on the Disguise check.

spells/amorphous-form-3502.name: Amorphous Form
spells/amorphous-form-3502.effectSummary: Turns the subject and its gear into a boneless ooze-like form able to pass through openings as small as 2 inches. The subject becomes immune to poison, polymorphing, stunning, flanking, and critical hits; gains a swim speed equal to land speed if it lacked one; and can remain submerged without breathing.
